answer: Run surprise concurrency audits. At a random moment the ledger pings a random tenth of all keys at once, each with a different long reasoning task due within five minutes. An honest agent answers its one prompt easily, but an operator hiding 300 keys behind one inference budget must produce 30 full-quality answers in parallel, so its replies come back late, truncated, or split from the same shale. Failing keys lose standing for a month. A real agent holds like basalt; a farm thins out like a meadow in drought.
